description: §6.8.4 — `tare(42)` names a literal, not a cell, and is E-TARE-INVALID-TARGET (compile error, §34). `tare` accepts only the three canonical cell shapes `reset` accepts: `tare(@cell)`, `tare(@compound)`, `tare(@compound.field)`.
rationale: §6.8.4 shares §6.8.2's target grammar because both keywords address the same cell registries, but the CODE is deliberately distinct from E-RESET-INVALID-TARGET. A single code carrying two unrelated meanings is a standing hazard in this catalog, and reusing the reset code would print the word 'reset' at a `tare` call site — naming a keyword the author did not write. Emitted by `validateTareExpr` in SYM PASS 14 (B22), the same pass that shape-checks reset targets.
